purpose: Deterministic Stage A observations transcribed from an SEC-furnished earnings exhibit and supported by filed periodic reports.

reporting_entity.consolidation_scope: PennyMac Financial Services, Inc. and consolidated subsidiaries

operating_structure.controlled_company: Private National Mortgage Acceptance Company, LLC

reporting_entity.entity_boundary_warning: PFSI, PNMAC, PLS, and PMT are distinct entities. PMT is separately listed and must not be collapsed into the PFSI reporting entity.

reporting_scope.segment_population: Servicing and subservicing on behalf of non-affiliate investors, early buyout transactions, servicing for PMT, and newly originated loans held for sale where stated

source_evidence.filing_status_basis: The Form 8-K states that the Item 2.02 information and exhibits are furnished and are not deemed filed for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.

bounded_exact_excerpt.text: MSRs are categorized as “Level 3” fair value assets. The Company uses a discounted cash flow approach to estimate the fair value of MSRs. Beginning in the third quarter of 2025, the Company enhanced its discounted cash flow approach to estimate the period-end fair value of its MSRs with the adoption of an Option-Adjusted Spread (“OAS”) model.
